title: Milestone 2026.04.55 Operational Retrospective — Full Analysis

experiment_table.note: Incremental test selection implemented: 0 of 554 tests selected, saving 562 min vs 562-min baseline. Largest single-milestone wall-time saving in project history.
JEPA v18 LambdaRank listwise loss achieves ood_auc=0.5115. Above random (0.50) for the first time across v15/v16/v17/v18, but below the 0.75 gate. FOURTH consecutive retrain below gate.
JEPA v18 cascade deploy gated on AUC. Exp 719 (FR-11 relay) blocked as downstream dependency.
FR-11 relay gated because JEPA v18 did not pass cascade deploy gate in Exp 718.
VR 200q Qwen run produces signed_improvement_200q=0.00510 > 0. First positive signed improvement across 20 VR attempts. Marginal but statistically non-zero. RETRO-033 verdict: resolved.
Gemma4 graduated threshold experiment blocked due to no GPU available. Rescheduled to .56.
PSV pool exhaustion diagnostic: condition_a_slope=0.0, condition_b_slope=0.00699248. Pool exhaustion not confirmed as root cause of PSV degradation. Gate fail: Exp 723 blocked.
PSV PaCoRe v2 recovery gated because pool exhaustion was not confirmed as root cause in Exp 722.
KAN distillation v3 AUROC=0.9078 >= 0.90 gate. Gate passed after two prior attempts (v1=0.7995, v2=0.8747). Deploy to production pipeline.
SC-Energy v2 ood_auc=0.6056. Above random but below the Tier 2 deployment threshold. Not a primary path candidate for .56.

JEPA-Reasoner Probe achieves ood_auc=1.0 on FoVer v2 OOD set, latency_p50=0.0196ms (both gates passed: AUC>=0.75, latency<1ms). This is the first Tier 2.1 candidate in project history. Escalates to primary verification path in .56.
Variable Granularity Gate skips Ising Tier 3 60% of the time with fn_delta=-0.042 (FN rate improved, not harmed). 7.2% latency reduction confirmed. Deploy alongside KAN in .56.

BatchedInferenceRunner optimization available if this recurs. RETRO-033 is now resolved (signed_improvement > 0), so Exp 720-class experiments may not recur in .56.

slowest5_composition_change.note: Complete slowest-5 turnover for first time in project history. All 5 prior entries were retired via Exp 703 in .54 (425, 410, 383, 380-382) or resolved (527 via RETRO-033 closure). New .55 slowest-5 consists entirely of first-appearance experiments, none of which exceeds 11 min. Maximum duration (Exp 720 at 10.96 min) is 79% below the 45-min governance threshold. The multi-year slowest-5 anchor pattern is broken.

verdict_jepa_v18_detail.resolution_path: Escalate to Tier 2.1 JEPAReasonerProbe (Exp 726) as primary verification path. Exp 726 achieved ood_auc=1.0. JEPA v18 cascade remains blocked but is no longer the blocking dependency for Phase 1 verification.

verdict_vr_retro033_detail.note: First positive signed improvement across all 20 VR attempts (Exp 720). Improvement is marginal (0.51%) but non-zero. RETRO-033 closes on first positive result per the closure condition. VR remains in .56 roadmap with a note that marginal results should be monitored for significance.

verdict_preflight_detail.note: Preflight v7 incremental test selection ran 0 tests (no source changes detected) in 2 seconds. Saved 562 baseline minutes. Wall time 0.0 is well below the 200-min threshold. This is the largest single-experiment wall-time saving in project history.

verdict_psv_detail.note: Pool exhaustion not confirmed as root cause. Condition A (small pool) shows slope=0.0 (flat, no improvement). Condition B (large pool) shows slope=0.00699248 (actively degrading). Since no slope < 0 was observed and root cause remains unidentified, PSV is still_degrading. Exp 723 PaCoRe v2 recovery was gated. RETRO-PSV-REGRESSION remains open.

verdict_fr11_detail.note: FR-11 relay was gated because JEPA v18 cascade deploy (Exp 718) failed its AUC gate. The FR-11 relay experiment requires a live cascade to log relay events. The relay infrastructure is specced and ready; the gate is the cascade AUC. Resolution path: deploy Tier 2.1 JEPAReasonerProbe (Exp 726, ood_auc=1.0) as the new cascade entrypoint, then re-run FR-11 in .56.

improvement_actions_for_56: PRIORITY 1 — PROMOTE TIER 2.1 JEPA-REASONER PROBE TO PRIMARY VERIFICATION PATH: Exp 726 achieved ood_auc=1.0 and latency_p50=0.0196ms on FoVer v2 OOD set. Both Tier 2.1 gates passed (AUC>=0.75, latency<1ms). This is the first Tier 2.1 candidate in project history. Wire Exp 726 probe architecture into the production verification pipeline in .56 as the primary Tier 2 path, replacing the blocked JEPA v18 cascade.

PRIORITY 2 — UNBLOCK FR-11 VIA TIER 2.1 PROBE CASCADE: FR-11 relay was gated on JEPA v18 cascade deploy failure. Now that Exp 726 provides a production-ready Tier 2.1 signal, re-run FR-11 relay in .56 using the probe cascade as the gate source. Expected outcome: relay_events_acked >= 1, closing RETRO-FR11.

PRIORITY 3 — DEPLOY KAN DISTILLATION v3 AND VARGRAN GATE: Exp 724 (AUROC=0.9078) passed the 0.90 KAN gate. Exp 727 (skip_rate=0.60, fn_delta=-0.042) passed the VarGran gate. Both are production-ready. Deploy in .56 pre-flight as standard pipeline components before any new training experiments.

PRIORITY 4 — PSV ROOT CAUSE INVESTIGATION BEFORE ANY .56 PSV ITERATION: Pool exhaustion was not confirmed as the root cause of PSV degradation (Exp 722). Condition A slope=0.0 (flat), Condition B slope=0.007 (degrading). The root cause is unknown. Before scheduling any .56 PSV experiment, run a corpus distribution audit: (1) compare held-out vs training FP rates to detect overfitting; (2) examine the difference between condition A and B (pool size) as a clue; (3) check if the self-play loop is creating circular reinforcement. Do not schedule PaCoRe v2 again until the root cause is identified.

GOVERNANCE RULE — INCREMENTAL TEST SELECTION MUST REMAIN ACTIVE: Preflight v7 saved 562 min in .55 by running 0 tests (no source changes detected). This must be validated at each .56 preflight. If source files change during the .56 cycle, incremental selection will run the affected tests, which is correct. The governance rule: wall_time_minutes from Exp 716-class preflight must remain < 200 min every milestone. If it exceeds 200 min, treat as a performance regression and investigate before running any .56 experiments.

MONITOR VR MARGINAL RESULT: RETRO-033 closes on the first positive signed_improvement (0.00510). But 0.51% is below typical significance thresholds. In .56, run a second 200q VR trial with a different seed and compare. If signed_improvement < 0 in the second trial, RETRO-033 should be re-opened. A single marginal positive result may be noise.

RETIRE JEPA v18 STANDALONE TRAINING EXPERIMENTS: After 4 consecutive failed retrains (v15: 0.4751, v16: 0.4759, v17: 0.4819, v18: 0.5115), the JEPA cascade-training approach has demonstrated diminishing returns. Add JEPA standalone training experiments to the exclusion manifest in .56 preflight. The Tier 2.1 probe architecture (Exp 726) provides a superior AUC=1.0 with lower training overhead. Resources freed by retiring JEPA training can be redirected to probe architecture development.

GEMMA4 GRADUATED THRESHOLD: Reschedule Exp 721 (Gemma4 graduated threshold, blocked due to no GPU in .55) for .56 cycle. This experiment requires GPU 0 allocation and should be scheduled as the first GPU-dependent experiment in .56 to ensure it is not blocked again.

RETRO-CRITICAL.note: JEPA cascade training approach retired after 4 failures. Tier 2.1 JEPAReasonerProbe (Exp 726) provides ood_auc=1.0 and passes both Tier 2.1 gates. RETRO-CRITICAL is effectively resolved via architectural pivot rather than training improvement. Recommend formal closure in .56.

RETRO-033.note: CLOSED. First positive signed improvement observed in Exp 720. Improvement is marginal; .56 should run a confirmation trial before treating as definitive.
